intermediate.name: Alto de Aledo
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Alto de Aledo (121.8 km)

story: A four-rider breakaway featuring Ethan Hayter was reeled in before halfway after a brief skirmish in the wind. Hayter went on the attack again later alongside Larry Warbasse and claimed the intermediate sprint, but Visma | Lease a Bike kept the race under control. The team delivered Matthew Brennan perfectly for the finale, where he sprinted to his third stage victory.
